note: Twin POC Muon arm - pinned recipe per docs/research/optimizer-sweep-2026-08.md section 5. lr/steps are filled from logs/plan.json (probe-picked) at launch; everything else is fixed here.

model.params_note: spec band was 100-150M; MiniCPM5 tokenizer vocab is 130k (4x the design 32K R-vocab) so the tied embedding alone is 100M. Hidden-matrix budget (the Muon-relevant part) is 106M. Deliberate overshoot, POC instrument.

excluded.lr: set to the AdamW arm probe winner for parity

qk_clip.applied: post-step, both arms, first-micro probe per step
qk_clip.gqa_rule: shared K head takes strongest gamma of its Q-group

schedule.shape: WSD: linear warmup 1.5 pct, constant, linear decay to 0.1x peak over final 20 pct

data.packing: overlap-1 consecutive stream chunks, eos separators
data.order: np.random.RandomState(1273+epoch) permutation - IDENTICAL for both arms
data.eval: eval.jsonl first 500 rows packed the same way; 431324 tokens / 1309158 bytes

precision: fp32 master weights + bf16 autocast; Muon NS in bf16; CE chunked+checkpointed (eager)
